stories.title: Delhi Police compile ‘database’ of potential protesters, make calls and visit homes ahead of October 10 Jantar Mantar protest

en.title: Delhi Police compile 'database' of potential protesters, make calls and visit homes ahead of October 10 Jantar Mantar protest
en.summary: Delhi Police are creating a database of potential protesters and contacting them ahead of a planned October 10 protest. Police are coordinating across states to prevent attendance, with over 200 social media groups under surveillance.

en.title: Delhi braces for CJP protest: 57 metro stations shut, trains cancelled, 23,000 security personnel deployed
en.summary: Delhi has implemented major security measures ahead of an October 10 CJP protest, including metro station closures, train cancellations, and deployment of 23,000 security personnel.

en.summary: Trump reposted criticism labeling the Nobel Peace Prize winner as an "America hater" after being passed over for the award. Pillay received the prize for promoting peace and international law.

en.title: Navi Pillay's Nobel Win Carries Family Story That Began On A Sugar Plantation
en.summary: Navi Pillay won the Nobel Prize, with her achievement reflecting a family history rooted in sugar plantation labor. She has characterized herself as an advocate for victims globally.

en.title: Jantar Mantar stir: Govt to shut internet for 24hrs within 4km radius in New Delhi
en.summary: Delhi authorities plan to disable internet access for 24 hours in a 4km radius around Jantar Mantar ahead of a proposed protest. Police held meetings to assess security arrangements and maintain law and order during the demonstration.

en.title: "If You Clap More...": Navi Pillay Jokes About Sharing Nobel Prize With Trump
en.summary: Navi Pillay made a lighthearted remark about potentially sharing her Nobel Prize with another recipient. The award will be formally presented at a ceremony in Oslo.

stories.title: 'I may share it with Trump': Navi Pillay jokes after winning Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: 'I may share it with Trump': Navi Pillay jokes after winning Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, born in Durban during apartheid to an Indian Tamil family, won the Nobel Peace Prize. She built a distinguished legal career serving on South Africa's high court and holding positions at international tribunals and the UN.

stories.title: 15,410% rally in 5 years! Multibagger Cupid shares jump 3% to hit fresh 52-week high

en.title: 15,410% rally in 5 years! Multibagger Cupid shares jump 3% to hit fresh 52-week high
en.summary: Cupid shares reached a new 52-week high of Rs 368, continuing gains for a fourth consecutive session. The company raised its FY27 revenue guidance to Rs 800 crore and net profit guidance to Rs 250 crore.

stories.title: Apollo, Max Health, other hospital stocks rally up to 5% despite cancer drug price caps. Why Jefferies stays bullish

en.title: Apollo, Max Health, other hospital stocks rally up to 5% despite cancer drug price caps. Why Jefferies stays bullish
en.summary: Hospital stocks rose up to 5% after the government capped trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30%. Analysts expect manageable earnings impacts despite near-term margin pressures, with several research firms maintaining bullish stances on major hospital operators.

en.title: Hexaware Technologies shares surge 11% on multi-year pact with Anthropic
en.summary: Hexaware Technologies shares surged following an announcement of a multi-year partnership with Anthropic to integrate Claude AI models into its platforms. The collaboration will focus on enterprise AI solutions for IT operations and software engineering.

stories.title: NCC shares jump 5% on Rs 1,286 crore Telangana road project order

en.title: NCC shares jump 5% on Rs 1,286 crore Telangana road project order
en.summary: NCC shares rose after securing a Rs 1,286.03 crore road construction order in Telangana from Hyderabad Growth Corridor Limited. The project involves constructing Radial Road-2 connecting the Outer Ring Road to Nacharam on NH-167N.

stories.title: ITC shares rise 2% a day after hitting a 52-week low following GQG’s Rs 9,395 crore stake sale. What lies ahead?

en.title: ITC shares rise 2% a day after hitting a 52-week low following GQG's Rs 9,395 crore stake sale. What lies ahead?
en.summary: ITC shares increased after GQG Partners reduced its stake through a Rs 9,395 crore share sale amid broader stock weakness. The company faces headwinds from cigarette taxes, inflation, and oil prices, with investors awaiting earnings results and analyst views on valuation.
